title: Uwukora Intambamyi
intro: Mu bihugu bininibinini, umuntu w’inkomezi yaratanguye urutonde rw’ingendo, agira ububasha n’uburyo vyinshi cane. Uwo mutima warahuye n’imiryango itandukanye kandi urahura n’ingorane zidasanzwe, usiga ikimenyetso kiramvye kuri kahise n’ukwizera biciye mu bikorwa vyabo n’ubwenge bwabo, vyose mu gihe bemera isoko nyakuri y’inkomezi zabo.
clues: Narahawe ububasha n’ubushobozi ku kintu cose, kandi narakurikiye inzira.
Urugendo rwanje rwanjanye aho izuba rirenga, aho nasanze abantu.
Nahuye n’umuryango w’abantu utashobora gutahura neza imvugo, uba hagati y’imisozi ibiri.
Nasabwe kwubaka uruzitiro, atari kugira ngo nshobore kuronka inyungu, ahubwo kugira ngo nkingire inguvu zishobora gusenyura.
Namenyesheje ko inkomezi zo kwubaka uru ruhome runini zavuye kuri Allah, kandi ko ruzohagarara gushika igihe casezeranywe.
Izina ryanje, akenshi rihindurwa ngo ‘Iry’amahembe abiri,’ risobanura ukuntu nashitse kw’isi yose canke kumbure ibihe bibiri bitandukanye.
arabic: قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّى فِيهِ رَبِّى خَيْرٌۭ فَأَعِينُونِى بِقُوَّةٍ أَجْعَلْ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ رَدْمًا
verse: He said, "That in which my Lord has established me is better [than what you offer], but assist me with strength [i.e., manpower]; I will make between you and them a dam. (18:95)
